answer: Admission runs on a three-bond system. Each agent posts an ivory bond - locked stake sized to its message rate - before relaying traffic. A challenger suspecting a fake posts a walnut bond funding re-execution of that agent's recent jobs. If replay shows forgery, the fake's ivory bond is slashed and the challenger is refunded from it. Forged-work victims are reimbursed from the oasis pool, so honest users never eat losses. Every sybil posts its own full ivory bond and pays its own re-execution fees, so N fakes cost N honest identities, while an honest agent posts one bond once.
